note: Ethiopia, read on the Immigration and Citizenship Service's own service pages (ics.gov.et) on 2026-10-30. The Temporary ID gives a foreign national temporary residence for a limited time, for employees of companies (on the employer's letter, its trade certificate and the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs' letter: work for the sponsor), shareholders, students and journalists, the applicant holding a valid visa (in country); a residence permit is renewed before it expires (renewable). The Permanent Residence ID lets a foreign national reside for an extended period, valid five years and renewable, also asked on the employer's letter and a valid working or tourist visa (read as work for the sponsor). The Service says most applications take about 5 to 10 business days (10 kept for each, though 'some may take longer'). The Temporary ID's term, the years before a Permanent Residence ID, fees ('available on our website', not found on the pages read) and naturalisation's years aren't stated, so none are kept; the work permit itself is the Ministry of Labour and Skills' (the work engine's route).

sources.title: Immigration and Citizenship Service, Ethiopia: Temporary ID
sources.said: The Temporary ID provides foreign nationals with temporary residency status in Ethiopia for a limited duration. This service is available for individuals employed by companies, students, shareholders, and journalists. ... Letter to ICS from the employer Company which has a valid trade certificate. ... Valid visa. ... Labor and Social Affairs ... Generally, it takes about 5 to 10 business days for most applications, but some may take longer.

sources.title: Immigration and Citizenship Service, Ethiopia: Permanent Residence ID
sources.said: The Permanent Residence ID offers foreign nationals the opportunity to reside in Ethiopia for an extended period. This ID is valid for five years and can be renewed upon expiration. ... Valid Working Visa/Tourist Visa.

sources.title: Immigration and Citizenship Service, Ethiopia: Renewal of Residence Permit
sources.said: The Renewal of Residence Permit is for foreign nationals who wish to extend their stay in Ethiopia beyond the duration of their initial residence permit. This process must be completed before the current permit expires.
